cases.source_profile: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3e regional stat block
cases.heading: Calimshan
cases.text: A populous realm under autocratic rule imports food and enslaved labor while exporting armor, gems, ships, silk, spices, weapons and wine. Mercantilism is a major livelihood and wealth strongly shapes social status.

cases.source_profile: Forgotten Realms Player's Guide 4e Waterdeep regional features
cases.heading: Waterdeep Regional Features
cases.text: The city is divided into wards and neighborhoods. It has an extensive sewer system maintained by a guild, a busy dock district, wealthy merchant quarters, caravan activity, trade hubs, walls and streets.

cases.source_profile: Neverwinter Campaign Setting 4e Thayan faction section
cases.heading: Thayans Goals
cases.text: A necromantic magocracy operates through agents in the region. Its lich commander seeks magical power, repairs a ritual fortress, searches for arcane energy and builds undead labor and fighting forces while concealing the scale of the operation.

cases.source_profile: Neverwinter Campaign Setting 4e New Neverwinter governance material
cases.heading: Lord Protector Policies
cases.text: The ruler relies on mercenary soldiers, imposes high taxes, faces opposition to his policies, shifts blame to officials, manipulates public opinion and uses administrators and enforcers to maintain political control.

cases.source_profile: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3e life and commerce
cases.heading: Home and Hearth
cases.text: Farmers raise livestock and grain, a mill processes food, households buy goods at a weekly market, pay rent, repair tools, cook meals and move produce by cart to a nearby town.

cases.source_profile: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting 3e magic and commerce
cases.heading: Magic in Society
cases.text: Wizards study spells through the Weave, portals connect distant places, wards protect towers and specialist merchants trade rare magical reagents and enchanted goods.

cases.heading: Pantheon and Churches
cases.text: Greater gods maintain divine realms, priests lead churches and sects, worshipers observe religious practices, and clerics receive divine magic to pursue the missions of their faiths.

cases.source_profile: Forgotten Realms Campaign Setting Box Set 1e introductory society
cases.heading: Introduction to the Realms
cases.text: City-states are expanding, farming and craft industries are common, merchants are becoming wealthier as markets and resources open, literacy is increasing and political consolidation is spreading into formerly wild lands.
